format.safe_margins: Keep faces, hands, and text inside a generous 9 percent inner margin.

global_dop_rules: Design each slide as a cinematic Indian slice-of-life still, not an illustrated quote card.
Both Aachu and Zuv must be emotionally legible in every two-shot.
Aachu's face must be visible whenever her action drives the slide.
Zuv must be active through gaze, gesture, posture, or care, never furniture.
No cropped-out faces, torso-only partner fragments, awkward wrist grabs, severed limbs, or accidental close-up crops.
Hands must communicate invitation, care, teasing, or mutual intimacy. If a handhold can read as restraint, the frame fails.
Use the Capricorn/Aries idea as subtext only. No zodiac symbols, wheels, constellations, labels, or infographic grammar.
The image must make sense with all text hidden.

style_direction.cinema_feel: warm modern Indian romantic slice-of-life, Tamasha-like emotional grammar without copying any exact filmmaker style
style_direction.palette: clean ivory/off-white paper, blue-grey evening, muted navy, denim, chai brown, warm skin tones, soft white, tiny red Aries accents
style_direction.avoid: yellow filter, parchment paper, oversaturated orange, generic AI watercolor, Bollywood poster drama, Canva template, meme page, flat zodiac infographic

slides.title: The Plan And The Spark
slides.emotional_purpose: Establish that his structure and her motion are opposite but already connected.
slides.visual_scene: A cozy balcony doorway at blue-grey evening. Zuv sits left at a small table with chai, notebook, and phone calendar. Aachu stands right, fully visible from head to mid-thigh, keys in one hand, the other hand open toward him in playful invitation.
slides.character_blocking: Zuv seated, angled toward Aachu, smiling with calm amused surrender. Aachu standing in a diagonal forward motion, face visible, eyes on him, not pulling his wrist. Their hands may lightly touch palm-to-palm or fingertips, reading invitation, not control.
slides.camera_composition: Medium-wide 4:5 frame, slight eye-level cinematic still. Text in top third. Couple lower two-thirds. Balcony door/railing creates depth. No body part cropped at face, wrist, or knees.
slides.lighting_color: Blue-grey evening outside, warm string lights inside, soft ivory paper, denim blue and small red keychain/dupatta accent.
slides.text_placement: Upper third, centered-left in clean wall/sky negative space.
slides.exact_text:
Capricorn man
Aries woman

he plans the future.
she starts it.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: he is planning; she is already ready to begin; he likes being interrupted.

slides.title: Too Late
slides.emotional_purpose: Her action outruns his deliberation without making him look foolish.
slides.visual_scene: Cafe table in soft daylight. Zuv is mid-thought with a notebook open and one gentle explaining hand. Aachu sits opposite, face fully visible, smiling at him while holding up her phone as if the booking is already done.
slides.character_blocking: Both seated three-quarter view. Zuv's gaze moves from her phone to her face. Aachu's shoulders lean forward, playful and decisive.
slides.camera_composition: Two-shot across cafe table, clean negative wall space above. Phone screen has non-readable shapes only.
slides.lighting_color: Soft cafe daylight, warm chai browns, muted brick/sage, tiny red phone case or nail accent.
slides.exact_text:
he says,
"let's think about it."

she says,
"too late."
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: he is thinking; she has already acted; neither is mocking the other.

slides.title: The Plot Twist
slides.emotional_purpose: Show her changing the plan as charm, not sabotage.
slides.visual_scene: A tabletop planning scene. Zuv and Aachu stand/sit side by side, both faces visible. Zuv holds a tidy checklist. Aachu adds a small red arrow or heart-sticker onto the page while grinning.
slides.character_blocking: Zuv watches her hand with an amused side-eye. Aachu leans into frame close to him, not behind him as a hidden torso.
slides.camera_composition: Over-table medium shot, faces in upper-middle, checklist in lower-middle, text above.
slides.lighting_color: Warm interior lamp, ivory paper, navy/denim, one red accent on the mark she adds.
slides.text_placement: Upper third with clear breathing room.
slides.exact_text:
he makes the plan.
she becomes the plot twist.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: his plan exists; her mark visibly changes it; he accepts the twist.

slides.title: Different Weather
slides.emotional_purpose: Conflict contrast, but safe and loving.
slides.visual_scene: A quiet home doorway or balcony corner after a disagreement. Zuv sits or stands still with soft worried eyes. Aachu stands facing him, expressive hands open as she speaks. Both faces visible.
slides.character_blocking: Small physical distance, no pointing fingers in anger. Zuv's posture is contained, not closed-off. Aachu is fiery but not cruel.
slides.camera_composition: Balanced two-shot with a doorway or curtain dividing stillness and motion naturally.
slides.lighting_color: Muted evening interior, soft navy shadows, warm skin tones, red accent in Aachu scarf/earring.
slides.exact_text:
he worries in silence.
she fights out loud.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: different emotional processing styles, not a toxic fight.

slides.title: Stability And Spark
slides.emotional_purpose: Turn the contrast into mutual care.
slides.visual_scene: Zuv gently fixes Aachu's bracelet, sleeve, or dupatta edge while she laughs mid-motion. Both faces visible and close enough for chemistry.
slides.character_blocking: Zuv's hand is careful and grounding. Aachu's body has movement, but she is looking back at him warmly.
slides.camera_composition: Intimate medium two-shot, hands visible in lower-middle, faces in upper-middle, no cramped crop.
slides.lighting_color: Soft golden lamp but neutral ivory paper, denim and lavender, tiny red accent.
slides.text_placement: Upper third, slightly right or centered depending on background space.
slides.exact_text:
he brings stability.
she brings spark.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: his steadiness helps her shine, not restrain her.

slides.title: Screenshots And Instinct
slides.visual_scene: At a doorway before going out. Zuv holds a phone with non-readable map/screenshot cards. Aachu points toward the road/lights outside, face visible and excited.
slides.character_blocking: Zuv looks from phone toward her direction, visibly deciding to follow. Aachu is forward-moving but not leaving the frame.
slides.camera_composition: Medium-wide doorway composition. Outside road/lights create depth. Text sits in upper interior wall area.
slides.lighting_color: Blue evening outside, warm doorway light inside, navy/denim, small red keychain.
slides.exact_text:
he saves screenshots.
she follows instinct.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: he has prepared; she has chosen; both move the story forward.

slides.title: He Loves The Chaos
slides.emotional_purpose: Reveal that his calm includes desire, attention, and fondness.
slides.visual_scene: Balcony night. Aachu dances under string lights, fully in frame with face visible. Zuv sits nearby with chai and closed notebook, watching her with a private smile.
slides.character_blocking: Aachu moves diagonally but stays inside safe frame. Zuv's eyes clearly follow her, shoulders softened, smile visible.
slides.camera_composition: Medium-wide 4:5 frame, not cropped into a torso. Aachu and Zuv both readable. Text upper third.
slides.lighting_color: Cool blue city night, warm bulbs, clean ivory paper, lavender/denim, tiny red key accent.
slides.exact_text:
he acts calm.
but he loves the chaos.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: she is alive; he is delighted by her; no cropped face, no restraint.

slides.title: Perfect Sense
slides.emotional_purpose: End with quiet acceptance after motion.
slides.visual_scene: Balcony floor or steps after the night has settled. Aachu and Zuv sit close, both faces visible. His notebook is closed, her keys rest nearby, phone face-down.
slides.character_blocking: Aachu leans near his shoulder; Zuv is relaxed and present. Both look peaceful, not posed.
slides.camera_composition: Soft medium-wide final frame with balanced negative space and emotional stillness.
slides.lighting_color: Blue-grey night softened by warm string lights, ivory paper, muted navy and soft white.
slides.text_placement: Upper third, centered in quiet negative space.
slides.logic_gate: Must read as: plans and spark have settled into belonging.
